text: 方案提出，到2030年，新型储能由规模化发展阶段步入市场化发展阶段，全国新型储能装机规模达到3亿千瓦，平均储能时长3小时左右。
text_en: The plan proposes that by 2030, new-type energy storage will move from the large-scale development stage to the market-based development stage, with nationwide installed new-type energy storage capacity reaching 300 million kilowatts and an average storage duration of about 3 hours.
